sub_graphs.name: Transaction Exception Hierarchy
sub_graphs.description: Defines the complete exception class hierarchy for invalid transactions in the Osaka fork. All exception classes inherit from InvalidTransaction (from ethereum.exceptions). This module establishes the error taxonomy for transaction validation failures.

invariants.text: All exception classes in this module MUST inherit from InvalidTransaction, ensuring a unified exception handling path for transaction validation.
Exception classes with Final-annotated fields are immutable after construction; their values are set once in __init__ and cannot be reassigned.

data_structures.name: InvalidTransaction
data_structures.description: Base exception class imported from ethereum.exceptions. Serves as the parent for all transaction-specific exceptions in this module.

sub_graphs.name: Transaction Type Validation Errors
sub_graphs.description: Handles errors related to EIP-2718 typed transaction envelope validation, including unknown transaction types and disallowed contract creation for certain transaction types.

invariants.text: TransactionTypeError stores the offending transaction_type as a Final[int], preserving the exact type byte that caused the failure for diagnostic purposes.
TransactionTypeContractCreationError stores the full Transaction object that attempted an illegal contract creation.

functions.description: Constructs a TransactionTypeError with the unknown transaction type byte.

parameters.name: transaction_type
parameters.description: The EIP-2718 transaction type byte that is not recognized.

parameters.name: transaction
parameters.description: The transaction that attempted disallowed contract creation.

state_variables.name: TransactionTypeError.transaction_type
state_variables.description: The type byte of the transaction that caused the error.

state_variables.name: TransactionTypeContractCreationError.transaction
state_variables.description: The transaction that caused the error.

data_structures.name: TransactionTypeContractCreationError
data_structures.description: Contract creation is not allowed for a transaction type.

pre_conditions.text: A transaction must have a recognized EIP-2718 type byte, otherwise TransactionTypeError is raised.
A transaction type must support contract creation if the transaction's 'to' field is empty, otherwise TransactionTypeContractCreationError is raised.

eip_references.context: TransactionTypeError references EIP-2718 typed transaction envelope standard.

sub_graphs.name: Blob Transaction Validation Errors
sub_graphs.description: Handles errors specific to EIP-4844 blob-carrying transactions, including blob gas limits, blob data presence, blob count limits, blob versioned hash validity, and blob gas pricing.

invariants.text: Blob transactions must contain at least one blob (enforced by NoBlobDataError).
Blob transactions must not exceed the maximum blob count (enforced by BlobCountExceededError).
Blob transactions must not exceed the maximum blob gas limit (enforced by BlobGasLimitExceededError).
All blob versioned hashes must be valid (enforced by InvalidBlobVersionedHashError).

data_structures.name: BlobGasLimitExceededError
data_structures.description: The blob gas limit for the transaction exceeds the maximum allowed.

data_structures.name: InsufficientMaxFeePerBlobGasError
data_structures.description: The maximum fee per blob gas is insufficient for the transaction.

data_structures.name: InvalidBlobVersionedHashError
data_structures.description: The versioned hash of the blob is invalid.

data_structures.name: NoBlobDataError
data_structures.description: The transaction does not contain any blob data.

data_structures.name: BlobCountExceededError
data_structures.description: The transaction has more blobs than the limit.

pre_conditions.text: Blob gas consumed by a transaction must not exceed the blob gas limit, otherwise BlobGasLimitExceededError is raised.
The transaction's max_fee_per_blob_gas must be sufficient to cover the current blob base fee, otherwise InsufficientMaxFeePerBlobGasError is raised.
All blob versioned hashes in the transaction must use a valid version prefix, otherwise InvalidBlobVersionedHashError is raised.
A blob transaction must include at least one blob, otherwise NoBlobDataError is raised.
The number of blobs in a transaction must not exceed the protocol-defined maximum, otherwise BlobCountExceededError is raised.

sub_graphs.name: Gas Fee Validation Errors
sub_graphs.description: Handles errors related to transaction gas fee validation, including insufficient max fee per gas and priority fee ordering violations.

invariants.text: A transaction's max_fee_per_gas must be greater than or equal to the block's base_fee_per_gas (enforced by InsufficientMaxFeePerGasError).
A transaction's max_priority_fee_per_gas must not exceed its max_fee_per_gas (enforced by PriorityFeeGreaterThanMaxFeeError).

functions.description: Constructs an InsufficientMaxFeePerGasError with the transaction's max fee and the block's base fee.

parameters.name: transaction_max_fee_per_gas
parameters.description: The maximum fee per gas specified in the transaction.

parameters.name: block_base_fee_per_gas
parameters.description: The base fee per gas of the block.

state_variables.name: InsufficientMaxFeePerGasError.transaction_max_fee_per_gas
state_variables.description: The maximum fee per gas specified in the transaction.

state_variables.name: InsufficientMaxFeePerGasError.block_base_fee_per_gas
state_variables.description: The base fee per gas of the block.

data_structures.name: InsufficientMaxFeePerGasError
data_structures.description: The maximum fee per gas is insufficient for the transaction.

data_structures.name: PriorityFeeGreaterThanMaxFeeError
data_structures.description: The priority fee is greater than the maximum fee per gas.

pre_conditions.text: The transaction's max_fee_per_gas must be >= the block's base_fee_per_gas, otherwise InsufficientMaxFeePerGasError is raised.
The transaction's max_priority_fee_per_gas must be <= max_fee_per_gas, otherwise PriorityFeeGreaterThanMaxFeeError is raised.

sub_graphs.name: Authorization and Code Size Validation Errors
sub_graphs.description: Handles errors related to EIP-7702 authorization list validation and EIP-3860 init code size limits.

invariants.text: Transactions with an authorization list must not have an empty list (enforced by EmptyAuthorizationListError).
Transaction init code must not exceed the maximum allowed size (enforced by InitCodeTooLargeError).

data_structures.name: EmptyAuthorizationListError
data_structures.description: The authorization list in the transaction is empty.

data_structures.name: InitCodeTooLargeError
data_structures.description: The init code of the transaction is too large.

pre_conditions.text: If a transaction includes an authorization list, it must not be empty, otherwise EmptyAuthorizationListError is raised.
The init code of a contract-creating transaction must not exceed the maximum allowed size, otherwise InitCodeTooLargeError is raised.

sub_graphs.name: Transaction Gas Limit Validation Error
sub_graphs.description: Handles the error case where a transaction specifies a gas limit exceeding the protocol-allowed maximum. Distinct from out-of-gas errors during EVM execution.

invariants.text: A transaction's gas limit must not exceed the protocol-defined maximum transaction gas limit (enforced by TransactionGasLimitExceededError).

data_structures.name: TransactionGasLimitExceededError
data_structures.description: The transaction has specified a gas limit that is greater than the allowed maximum.

pre_conditions.text: A transaction's gas_limit must not exceed the maximum allowed gas limit for a single transaction, otherwise TransactionGasLimitExceededError is raised.

sub_graphs.name: Protocol Constants and System Addresses
sub_graphs.description: Defines all module-level constants governing block gas mechanics, blob gas limits, EIP-1559 parameters, system contract addresses, and block size constraints for the Osaka fork.

invariants.text: ELASTICITY_MULTIPLIER is 2; the gas target is always half the gas limit.
BASE_FEE_MAX_CHANGE_DENOMINATOR is 8; the base fee can change by at most 12.5% per block.
GAS_LIMIT_MINIMUM is 5000; no block may have a gas limit below this floor.
MAX_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK equals BLOB_SCHEDULE_MAX * GAS_PER_BLOB; total blob gas per block is bounded.
MAX_RLP_BLOCK_SIZE equals MAX_BLOCK_SIZE - SAFETY_MARGIN (10485760 - 2097152 = 8388608 bytes).
BLOB_COUNT_LIMIT is 6; no single transaction may carry more than 6 blobs.
VERSIONED_HASH_VERSION_KZG is 0x01; all blob versioned hashes must begin with this byte.

eip_references.context: BASE_FEE_MAX_CHANGE_DENOMINATOR and ELASTICITY_MULTIPLIER govern the EIP-1559 base fee adjustment mechanism.
BEACON_ROOTS_ADDRESS is the system contract for storing beacon block roots in the EVM.
MAX_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK, VERSIONED_HASH_VERSION_KZG, and BLOB_COUNT_LIMIT govern blob transaction constraints.
WITHDRAWAL_REQUEST_PREDEPLOY_ADDRESS is the system contract for execution layer withdrawal requests.
CONSOLIDATION_REQUEST_PREDEPLOY_ADDRESS is the system contract for validator consolidation requests.
HISTORY_STORAGE_ADDRESS is the system contract for storing block hash history.

sub_graphs.name: BlockChain Data Structure
sub_graphs.description: Defines the BlockChain dataclass that holds the history and current state of the block chain, consisting of a list of blocks, the global state, and a chain identifier.

invariants.text: The blocks list is trimmed to at most 255 entries after each state transition.

sub_graphs.name: Fork Transition (apply_fork)
sub_graphs.description: Transforms the state from the previous hard fork into the block chain object for the Osaka fork. For Osaka, this is a no-op identity transformation.

invariants.text: The apply_fork function returns the input unchanged; Osaka introduces no irregular state transition.

functions.description: Transforms the state from the previous hard fork into the block chain object for this hard fork. For Osaka, returns the input unchanged.

returns.description: Upgraded block chain object for this hard fork

pre_conditions.text: The old BlockChain must be a valid chain from the previous fork.

post_conditions.text: The returned BlockChain is identical to the input (identity transformation).

sub_graphs.name: Block Hash History Retrieval
sub_graphs.description: Retrieves the last 256 block hashes in order of increasing block number for use by the BLOCKHASH opcode.

invariants.text: The returned list contains at most 256 hashes in order of increasing block number.
Only the most recent block's hash is computed via keccak256; all others are obtained from successor parent_hash fields.

functions.description: Obtains the list of hashes of the previous 256 blocks in order of increasing block number.

pre_conditions.text: The chain must contain at least one block for meaningful output.

post_conditions.text: Returns an empty list if chain has no blocks; otherwise returns up to 256 hashes.

sub_graphs.name: Core State Transition
sub_graphs.description: The primary entry point for applying a block to the chain. Validates block size, header, ommers (must be empty), executes the block body, and verifies all output roots and hashes match the block header.

invariants.text: Block RLP size must not exceed MAX_RLP_BLOCK_SIZE (8388608 bytes).
Ommers tuple must be empty (post-merge requirement).
After execution, computed gas_used, transactions_root, state_root, receipt_root, bloom, withdrawals_root, blob_gas_used, and requests_hash must all match the block header.
After appending, chain.blocks is trimmed to at most 255 entries.

functions.description: Attempts to apply a block to an existing block chain.

returns.description: Mutates chain in place; raises InvalidBlock on failure

pre_conditions.text: The chain must have at least one existing block (for parent header lookup).
The block must be valid: RLP size within bounds, correct header, empty ommers.

post_conditions.text: On success, block is appended to chain.blocks.
chain.blocks length is at most 255 after successful transition.
chain.state is updated with all transaction effects, withdrawals, and system calls.

state_transitions.text: Chain state is mutated via apply_body; the block is appended to the blocks list; blocks list is trimmed to 255.

sub_graphs.name: EIP-1559 Base Fee Calculation
sub_graphs.description: Calculates the base fee per gas for a block using the EIP-1559 mechanism.

invariants.text: When parent gas used equals target, base fee is unchanged from parent.
When parent gas used exceeds target, base fee increases by at least 1 unit.
The maximum base fee change per block is parent_base_fee / BASE_FEE_MAX_CHANGE_DENOMINATOR (12.5%).
Gas limit must satisfy check_gas_limit constraints relative to parent, otherwise block is invalid.

functions.signature: calculate_base_fee_per_gas(block_gas_limit: Uint, parent_gas_limit: Uint, parent_gas_used: Uint, parent_base_fee_per_gas: Uint) -> Uint
functions.description: Calculates the base fee per gas for the block based on the parent block's utilization relative to its gas target.

returns.description: Base fee per gas for the block

pre_conditions.text: block_gas_limit must pass check_gas_limit against parent_gas_limit, otherwise InvalidBlock is raised.

post_conditions.text: Returns the expected base fee per gas for the block as a Uint.

eip_references.context: Implements the base fee adjustment algorithm from EIP-1559.

sub_graphs.name: Block Header Validation
sub_graphs.description: Verifies a block header against the parent header and protocol rules.

invariants.text: Block number must be >= 1 and exactly parent.number + 1.
Timestamp must be strictly greater than parent timestamp.
Gas used must not exceed gas limit.
Base fee must match calculate_base_fee_per_gas result.
Excess blob gas must match calculate_excess_blob_gas result from parent.
Extra data must be at most 32 bytes.
Difficulty must be 0 (proof-of-stake).
Nonce must be 8 zero bytes (proof-of-stake).
Ommers hash must equal EMPTY_OMMER_HASH.
Parent hash must equal keccak256(rlp.encode(parent_header)).

returns.description: Raises InvalidBlock if any validation check fails

eip_references.context: Validates excess_blob_gas against calculate_excess_blob_gas from parent header.
Validates base_fee_per_gas using calculate_base_fee_per_gas.
Post-merge PoS fields: difficulty must be 0, nonce must be zero bytes, ommers hash must be empty.

sub_graphs.name: Transaction Includability Check
sub_graphs.description: Validates whether a transaction is includable in the current block. Checks gas availability, blob gas limits, sender recovery, fee market rules, blob transaction constraints, SetCode transaction constraints, nonce matching, balance sufficiency, and EOA sender requirement.

invariants.text: Transaction gas must not exceed remaining block gas (block_gas_limit - block_gas_used).
Transaction blob gas must not exceed remaining blob gas (MAX_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK - blob_gas_used).
For EIP-1559/4844/7702 txs: max_fee_per_gas >= max_priority_fee_per_gas and max_fee_per_gas >= base_fee_per_gas.
For legacy txs: gas_price >= base_fee_per_gas.
BlobTransaction must have 1 to BLOB_COUNT_LIMIT (6) blobs, all with VERSIONED_HASH_VERSION_KZG prefix (0x01).
BlobTransaction and SetCodeTransaction must not create contracts (to must be an Address).
SetCodeTransaction must have a non-empty authorization list.
Sender nonce must exactly match transaction nonce.
Sender balance must cover max_gas_fee + tx.value (plus blob fee for blob txs).
Sender must be an EOA (no code) or have a valid EIP-7702 delegation.

functions.signature: check_transaction(block_env: vm.BlockEnvironment, block_output: vm.BlockOutput, tx: Transaction) -> Tuple[Address, Uint, Tuple[VersionedHash, ...], U64]
functions.description: Checks if the transaction is includable in the block.

eip_references.context: Effective gas price calculation.
Blob transaction validation: versioned hash prefix check, blob count limits, blob gas price check.
SetCodeTransaction requires non-empty authorization list and Address-type 'to' field.

sub_graphs.name: Receipt Construction
sub_graphs.description: Constructs the receipt for an executed transaction.

invariants.text: Receipt succeeded field is True if and only if there was no error in the top-level frame.

functions.signature: make_receipt(tx: Transaction, error: Optional[EthereumException], cumulative_gas_used: Uint, logs: Tuple[Log, ...]) -> Bytes | Receipt
functions.description: Makes the receipt for a transaction that was executed.

sub_graphs.name: System Transaction Processing
sub_graphs.description: Handles execution of system transactions (EIP-4788 beacon roots, EIP-2935 block hash history, EIP-7002 withdrawal requests, EIP-7251 consolidation requests).

invariants.text: System transactions always originate from SYSTEM_ADDRESS (0xff...fe).
System transactions use SYSTEM_TRANSACTION_GAS (30M) gas.
System transactions use base_fee_per_gas as their gas price.
System transactions transfer zero value and have empty access lists, no blob hashes, and no authorizations.
Checked system transactions reject blocks if target has no code or execution fails.
Unchecked system transactions silently tolerate missing code and execution failures.
System transaction messages have should_transfer_value=False, is_static=False, disable_precompiles=False, depth=0.

functions.signature: process_system_transaction(block_env: vm.BlockEnvironment, target_address: Address, system_contract_code: Bytes, data: Bytes) -> MessageCallOutput
functions.description: Processes a system transaction with the given code.

functions.signature: process_checked_system_transaction(block_env: vm.BlockEnvironment, target_address: Address, data: Bytes) -> MessageCallOutput
functions.description: Processes a system transaction and raises InvalidBlock if contract has no code or execution fails.

functions.signature: process_unchecked_system_transaction(block_env: vm.BlockEnvironment, target_address: Address, data: Bytes) -> MessageCallOutput
functions.description: Processes a system transaction without checking code or failure.

pre_conditions.text: For checked system transactions: target address must contain code, otherwise InvalidBlock is raised.
For checked system transactions: execution must succeed, otherwise InvalidBlock is raised.

state_transitions.text: System contract code is executed against the block state; any state mutations from the contract execution are applied.

eip_references.context: Beacon roots contract invoked via unchecked system transaction.
History storage contract invoked via unchecked system transaction.
Withdrawal request contract invoked via checked system transaction.
Consolidation request contract invoked via checked system transaction.

sub_graphs.name: Block Body Execution (apply_body)
sub_graphs.description: Executes the full block body in the correct ordering: (1) unchecked system call to beacon roots, (2) unchecked system call to history storage, (3) process all user transactions sequentially, (4) process withdrawals, (5) process general-purpose requests.

invariants.text: System calls to beacon roots and history storage are unchecked and happen before any user transactions.
All user transactions are processed sequentially in block order with indices 0..n-1.
Withdrawals are processed after all transactions.
General-purpose requests are processed last, after withdrawals.

functions.signature: apply_body(block_env: vm.BlockEnvironment, transactions: Tuple[LegacyTransaction | Bytes, ...], withdrawals: Tuple[Withdrawal, ...]) -> vm.BlockOutput

state_transitions.text: State is mutated sequentially by: (1) beacon root system call, (2) history storage system call, (3) each user transaction, (4) withdrawals, (5) general-purpose requests.

eip_references.context: First operation: unchecked system call to BEACON_ROOTS_ADDRESS.
Second operation: unchecked system call to HISTORY_STORAGE_ADDRESS.

sub_graphs.name: General-Purpose Request Processing (EIP-7685)
sub_graphs.description: Processes all EIP-7685 general-purpose requests at the end of block execution. Parses deposit requests from receipts, calls withdrawal and consolidation predeploys via checked system transactions.

invariants.text: Requests are appended in ascending order of request type: deposits, then withdrawals, then consolidations.
Withdrawal and consolidation request system calls are checked; if code is missing or call fails, the block is invalid.
Deposit requests are parsed from existing block output logs, not from system calls.
Empty return data from system calls results in no request entry being appended for that type.

functions.description: Processes all the requests in the block.

state_transitions.text: block_output.requests is populated with deposit, withdrawal, and consolidation request data in ascending type order.

eip_references.context: General-purpose execution layer request framework.
Deposit requests parsed from block output logs.
Withdrawal requests from WITHDRAWAL_REQUEST_PREDEPLOY_ADDRESS.
Consolidation requests from CONSOLIDATION_REQUEST_PREDEPLOY_ADDRESS.

sub_graphs.name: Transaction Execution (process_transaction)
sub_graphs.description: Executes a single transaction within a block. Performs validation, sender recovery, gas fee deduction, access list setup, EIP-7702 authorization handling, EVM execution, EIP-7623 gas refund calculation with calldata floor, miner fee transfer, account destruction, and receipt/trie updates.

invariants.text: The sender's balance is debited by effective_gas_fee + blob_gas_fee before execution.
After execution, gas refund is min(gas_used_before_refund / 5, refund_counter).
EIP-7623: Final gas used is max(gas_used_after_refund, calldata_floor_gas_cost).
Unused gas is refunded to the sender at effective_gas_price.
Priority fee (effective_gas_price - base_fee_per_gas) times gas used is transferred to coinbase.
Accounts marked for deletion are destroyed after execution.
The coinbase address is always added to the access list addresses.

functions.signature: process_transaction(block_env: vm.BlockEnvironment, block_output: vm.BlockOutput, tx: Transaction, index: Uint) -> None
functions.description: Executes a transaction against the provided environment.

pre_conditions.text: Transaction must pass validate_transaction (intrinsic gas and calldata floor gas cost).
Transaction must pass check_transaction (gas availability, fees, nonce, balance, sender validity).

post_conditions.text: Sender balance reflects gas fee deduction, execution, and refund.
Coinbase balance is credited with the priority fee portion of gas used.
block_output.block_gas_used is increased by the final gas used.
block_output.blob_gas_used is increased by the transaction's blob gas.
Transaction is recorded in transactions_trie and receipt in receipts_trie.

state_transitions.text: Sender nonce incremented. Sender balance debited for gas+blob fees, then credited for refund. Coinbase credited with priority fee. Accounts to delete destroyed. block_output accumulators updated.

eip_references.context: Effective gas price and priority fee calculation.
Access list processing.
Blob gas fee calculation.
Authorization tuple handling for SetCodeTransaction.
Calldata floor gas cost.
Gas refund capped at gas_used_before_refund / 5.

sub_graphs.name: Withdrawal Processing
sub_graphs.description: Processes beacon chain withdrawals by increasing the balance of each withdrawal recipient. Amounts in Gwei converted to Wei by multiplying by 10^9.

invariants.text: Withdrawal amounts are in Gwei and multiplied by 10^9 to convert to Wei.
Withdrawals only increase recipient balances; they never decrease any balance.
Each withdrawal is RLP-encoded and stored in the withdrawals trie at its sequential index.

functions.signature: process_withdrawals(block_env: vm.BlockEnvironment, block_output: vm.BlockOutput, withdrawals: Tuple[Withdrawal, ...]) -> None
functions.description: Increases the balance of withdrawing accounts.

post_conditions.text: Each withdrawal recipient's balance is increased by withdrawal.amount * 10^9 Wei.

state_transitions.text: Each withdrawal recipient's balance is increased by withdrawal.amount * 10^9 Wei via modify_state.

eip_references.context: Implements beacon chain push withdrawals as balance increases.

sub_graphs.name: Gas Limit Validation
sub_graphs.description: Validates that a block's gas limit is within acceptable bounds relative to the parent block's gas limit.

invariants.text: Gas limit must be strictly less than parent_gas_limit + max_adjustment_delta.
Gas limit must be strictly greater than parent_gas_limit - max_adjustment_delta.
Gas limit must be at least GAS_LIMIT_MINIMUM (5000).
max_adjustment_delta = parent_gas_limit // GAS_LIMIT_ADJUSTMENT_FACTOR (1024).

functions.description: Validates the gas limit for a block.

returns.description: True if gas limit constraints are satisfied
